title: io.loams.dev.usage.node.memory.v1
description: The `data` of a `io.loams.dev.usage.node.memory.v1` usage event: Memory of one tenant resource over one window (the node agent). Producer: loams-meter-agent. Design §63 §6.3. Measured values are integers in the unit named; dimensions are strings. New optional fields may be added within v1.

byte_seconds.description: Memory integrated over the window, byte-seconds

resource.description: The measured resource: a sandbox, runtime or pod (the agent's resolver)

function.description: The function the resource runs, when there is one

tier.description: The isolation tier: T0, T1 or T2
